meaning: Provider response appears to offer a route denominator feed with permission path and enough documentation to justify source-admission review
minimum_evidence: Written permission or contract path; actual routes_run; reproducible feed path; identity fields; coverage; row grain; allowed internal use
allowed_next_action: Open separate source-admission lane; request contract/legal review; request schema sample without raw player rows if needed
not_allowed: Do not ingest production data; do not calculate YPRR/TPRR; do not promote source truth
notes: Green here means path possible, not source approved.

meaning: Provider response is promising but missing at least one required gate
minimum_evidence: Some route feed confirmation but missing license, row grain, identity, coverage, missingness, export, or allowed-use terms
allowed_next_action: Send follow-up questions; keep source blocked
not_allowed: Do not ingest data; do not treat interest as admission

meaning: Provider denies use, prohibits required use case, lacks route data, or cannot provide a permission-safe feed
minimum_evidence: Explicit denial, unavailable field, no allowed storage/use, no export, or no identity-safe path
allowed_next_action: Record blocker and close provider lead unless facts change
not_allowed: Do not use public snippets, client objects, paid pages, or scraped data
notes: Use for no-license or no-feed outcomes.

meaning: Provider may offer route data only through a paid/proprietary contract
minimum_evidence: Paid license or sales path required; no public/permission-free use
allowed_next_action: Escalate to contract/business owner if NWR wants pricing review
not_allowed: Do not use any data before contract and source admission

meaning: No provider reply has been received
minimum_evidence: Outreach not sent or no response after sending
allowed_next_action: Track follow-up date; optionally send reminder after approved interval
not_allowed: Do not infer permission from silence
notes: Default initial status for every target.
